title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.67 (quiet) at 23:00 UTC on 28 September 2026.

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.67 (1M) at 23:00 UTC on 28 September. The 23:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 23:59; hour-start 0.67/1M, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-28T22:42:00Z; label 1M). Published-window maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-09-28T20:26:00Z; label 1Z). Window start 2026-09-28T18:58:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 00:00 UTC hour on 29 September is still incomplete (56 samples through 00:55).

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (23:00 UTC on 28 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
